known_design_decisions.minimum_created_at: Use exact trusted original manifest creation time; not a new capture or clock reset.
known_design_decisions.new_negative_scope: Only a genuinely new transport framing/incomplete-capture/writer/link partition if justified; no repeat existing bundle corruption tests.
known_design_decisions.original_configuration_policy_release: Stay on Ubuntu separate from transport; never exported or rewritten.
known_design_decisions.private_signer_material: Never read or copied; no actual signing worker in this task.

no_repeated_partitions: No new backup capture, test body, RPC, signing, observer delivery, journal reconciliation or old bundle-tamper suite.
Existing component integrity/exact allocation/source-profile proofs retain original scope; new evidence concerns authenticated transport, desktop-held bytes and returned Linux review-only restore.
objective: Authenticate possession of the exact already-reviewed c821 unsigned package on the Windows desktop, then return those desktop-held bytes to a fresh isolated Ubuntu review-only restore without signing, configuration export or source adoption.
remaining_before_execution: Final Windows verifier/transport schema/server helper/worker source and fixed-path commands must be reviewed before approval.
All new private service properties, resource bounds, trusted pin provenance and preservation predicates must be bound into frozen preparation.

required_acceptance.goal: Trusted pins originate separately from the exported packet and cannot be silently recomputed to accept drift.

Read-only c821 export is closed to exactly five regular single-link raw files; no signer/config/policy/source-release export. Source records and four original c821 service groups inspected before and after, never changed/control-restarted.

Windows bounded verification authenticates exact outer pin, exact member set/hash/length/nested pin and typed structural bindings; explicitly not original Linux configuration/source/current-chain admission.
Write actual five desktop-held files to fresh exclusive output and reread their bytes; return packet is rebuilt from these persisted files, not cached original export response or a new server copy.
Both source and return transport use pinned authenticated host transport; frame lengths/global bytes/duplicate keys/base64 and expected path set validated before output allocation.

Remote install writes only new fixed c823 paths exclusively with complete-publication marker last; partials preserved, no overwrite or cleanup fallback. Rehash installed returned bytes before worker execution.

Actual existing keeper verify/restore and sidecar verify/restore run unsigned in one isolated Ubuntu worker with original server-only policy/config/source identities and two distinct root000 empty read-only signer masks.

Keep real wall time. Caller explicitly reviews historical recovery max_age86400 and original captured minimum; original operating max_backup_age900, all raw timestamps, pending nonce/cost/first_seen/outbox IDs and policy/config bytes remain unchanged.

Reconcile returned input and both fresh restored layouts byte-for-byte, generation identity and false readiness/fencing/freshness/install/restart fields; original/source inventories and groups unchanged; all newly owned units stopped.

review_focus: Fixed relative paths and exact five-member allowlist; no path traversal/unknown metadata/duplicate JSON names/nonfinite values.
Descriptor/aggregate/wire/base64 bounds before reads/decode/write; resource ceilings and default16MiB/60s unchanged.
Exclusive fresh publication and complete-read semantics; no final path visible with incomplete bytes, no transient hardlink-count false refusal, no source mutation.
Parent/descriptor/path identity during read/write/readback; reject symlink/reparse/hardlink aliases where applicable without claiming Unix ownership controls on Windows.
Windows structural/hash result cannot grant Linux source/config/current-chain validation, freshness, signer fencing or operation readiness.
Source fencing is a point-in-time readback of the exact original four c821 groups and their queued/automatic restart state, not cross-host fencing.
Returned bytes must genuinely originate from persisted off-host desktop files; both independent copy inventories and manifest pins retained.
No claim of second-Linux-host failover, production backup retention/durability, host-loss recovery, canonical latest state or independent launch approval.
